description: ExaGO is a power-grid optimisation toolkit developed through the ExaSGD project and now maintained in Oak Ridge National Laboratory's repository. C/C++ applications and Python bindings solve AC optimal power flow, multiperiod, security-constrained and stochastic formulations on CPU or compatible GPU systems. OPFLOW accepts MATPOWER network files and writes solved results in MATPOWER or JSON form; other applications add their documented scenario settings. Coverage is global and user-defined, with network detail and time periods supplied by each study. Public source and build/use documentation are free under a UT-Battelle permissive licence requiring notices, change attribution and an acknowledgement. External solver and library terms remain separate. A limitation is that solver support differs by application, and some HiOp paths also require Ipopt. GPU operation needs compatible RAJA/UMPIRE builds, while parts of the developer documentation are marked outdated. The toolkit supports grid operation and contingency studies and directly uses the format of MATPOWER (model-matpower). The older PNNL repository points to this successor. No binaries, models or HPC jobs were obtained or run.
